full_judgment: 4. The contention of defendants 1-3 is that the suit is barred by limitation and 0.76 acres of CS and SA plots 447, 448 corresponding to RS plots 952, 953 as well as City Survey plots 2024, 2025 are correctly prepared in the name of defendant 1 in khas khatian 1 in which defendant 1 maintain possession and control.
